newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls two points to 730.3 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls two points to 730.3 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, fell 2.0 points on Friday to 730.3 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Five of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the machinery index losing the most, down 17.2 points to 877.1.
Five indices rose, with the investment fund index rising the most, up 10.8 points to 1,032.6.
